source.title: Mexico City Grand Prix 2026 Tyre Strategy: One Stop or Two?

chart.evidence: Mexico City Grand Prix 2026 tyre strategy showing Pirelli's remaining race tyre sets for all 22 drivers, with new and used C3 Hard, C4 Medium and C5 Soft allocations. Mexico City Grand Prix 2026 Tyre Strategy 7 Pirelli’s official race tyre allocation for the 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix shows the new and used sets available to each driver. Hamilton, Russell and Hadjar have no new Soft tyres, while every driver retains one new Medium and one new Hard. © Pirelli Motorsport.
